import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect loaded data (optional, can be commented out)
    # print(df_students.head())
    # print(df_schools.head())
    
    # The target schema is:
    # ['Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str, 'school_name': str,
    #  'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int, 'School ID': int, 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int]
    #
    # Source0 has student info + scores but no school details except school_name.
    # Source1 has school details keyed by School ID and school_name.
    #
    # We need to join student records with their corresponding school info.
    #
    # Join condition: df_students.school_name == df_schools.school_name
    # This is the only common column to join on.
    #
    # After join, we will have all columns needed.
    #
    # Data types will be enforced after join.
    
    # Merge on 'school_name' to bring school info into student records
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_students, df_schools, on="school_name", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
    
    # Rename columns or reorder to match target schema exactly
    # Target columns order:
    target_columns = [
        'Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
        'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget'
    ]
    
    # Ensure all target columns exist after merge
    missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_merged.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after merge: {missing_cols}")
    
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns].copy()
    
    # Enforce data types as per target schema
    df_target['Student ID'] = df_target['Student ID'].astype(int)
    df_target['student_name'] = df_target['student_name'].astype(str)
    df_target['gender'] = df_target['gender'].astype(str)
    df_target['grade'] = df_target['grade'].astype(str)
    df_target['school_name'] = df_target['school_name'].astype(str)
    df_target['reading_score'] = df_target['reading_score'].astype(int)
    df_target['math_score'] = df_target['math_score'].astype(int)
    df_target['School ID'] = df_target['School ID'].astype(int)
    df_target['type'] = df_target['type'].astype(str)
    df_target['size'] = df_target['size'].astype(int)
    df_target['budget'] = df_target['budget'].astype(int)
    
    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {target_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
